mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed(user_id, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE feed SET content = #{feed.content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM feed WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM feed ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM feed WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT f.id, f.user_id, f.content, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM feed f LEFT JOIN feed_hashtag fh ON f.id = fh.feed_id LEFT JOIN hashtag h ON fh.hashtag_id = h.id WHERE (h.name = #{hashtag} OR f.content LIKE CONCAT('%#', #{hashtag}, '%')) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC;
SELECT id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM feed WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT f.id, f.user_id, f.content, f.created_at, f.updated_at, CASE WHEN h.name = #{keyword} THEN 1 -- 정확한 해시태그 매칭 WHEN f.content LIKE CONCAT('%#', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 -- 피드 내 #태그 매칭 ELSE 3 END as search_priority FROM feed f LEFT JOIN feed_hashtag fh ON f.id = fh.feed_id LEFT JOIN hashtag h ON fh.hashtag_id = h.id WHERE ( h.name = #{keyword} -- 1. 정확한 해시태그명 매칭 OR f.content LIKE CONCAT('%#', #{keyword}, '%') -- 2. 피드 내용의 #키워드 매칭 ) ORDER BY search_priority ASC, f.created_at DESC;
